notes:
Account overview:
- Mid-market e-commerce SaaS focused on post-purchase customer experience (returns, shipping updates, RMAs).
- Primary product: post-purchase chat agent integrated into merchant storefronts and merchant support portals.
- Seasonality: heavy peaks during holiday windows (Nov-Dec) and flash sales; expected traffic can spike ~3x baseline for short windows.

Workload & requirements (from discovery/demo):
- Workload: conversational chat agent for returns/shipping + automated RMA creation (tool calls into merchant APIs).
- Key SLO: p95 response latency target ~<=250-300ms for streaming chat messages during normal and degraded modes.
- Throughput: baseline 60-100 concurrent chat sessions, peak concurrency ~300-400. Target sustained token throughput estimates provided in deck.
- Functional needs: streaming responses, tool-calling (order lookup, create-RMA, shipping labels), structured JSON output for downstream workflows.
- Model preferences: prefer open/hosted models for cost and control (Llama-family / Mistral-like), but open to Redwood-curated models if latency/cost win.
- Fallback routing: want automatic fallback to smaller / quantized variants under heavy load.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate - willing to pay for Dedicated for predictable peak capacity but need clear unit economics (cost per session) for approval.

Security & compliance:
- Requires SSO/SAML for admin console, audit logs for tool calls, KMS integration for keys, retention controls and EU data residency for some merchants.
- Security questionnaire started; security team provided initial answers 2026-02-08; still missing details on network isolation for Dedicated.

Timeline & recent activity:
- 2026-01-12: Intro discovery call (AE Aisha + SE Miguel).
- 2026-01-20: Product demo (streaming + tool calling) - Fireflies ff_2026-01-20_0117.
- 2026-02-03: Sent security questionnaire; drive link with answers created.
- 2026-02-08: Follow-up on demo; agreed to hosted POC focusing on 95th percentile latency.
- 2026-02-14: POC config deployed (hosted) with sample dataset and synthetic traffic; monitoring in progress.

POC goals / acceptance criteria:
- Validate p95 latency <=300ms with streaming enabled for median prompt sizes (orders lookups + 2 tool calls).
- Demonstrate graceful degradation: fall back to quantized variant or reduced context with <2x latency increase under peak load.
- Show reliable tool-calling with at-least-once semantics and audit entries in logs.
- Provide cost projection for Dedicated reserved pool sized for holiday peak (3x baseline) and burst pricing.

Quotes / seller notes:
- "We can't have chat wait more than ~250ms p95 during the returns flow - merchant ops will reject if it's slower." - Head of Product (call 1).
- AE notes: customer likes Redwood's streaming demo; main hesitation is proving p95 at scale and pricing math for Dedicated.

Next steps (short):
- SE (Miguel) to run 48-72h baseline perf tests and share p95/time series + token cost breakdown.
- AE (Aisha) to share Dedicated pricing ranges and sample reserved pool configs.
- Customer to provide 1-week sample of real production request traces and ~1000 representative prompts for eval.
